comment: First-person tuning (centimetres, seconds, degrees). Starting values for the creator's playtest; see Docs/FirstPerson.md.

stats.comment: The seven stats at fixed prototype values. Intelligence and Faith speed Qhi regeneration, Dexterity Stamina recovery, Martial Prowess physical damage and the shove; each point above base adds the given share.

wolf.comment: The Chapel wolf (placeholder). Distances in cm, frames at 60 per second. leaveLineY / leaveMaxZ: the Chapel's floor ends here; the Threshold Hall's floor beyond (below leaveMaxZ) counts as outside, the loft above it does not. The creator's 'Chapel Wolves' document (2026-11-23): warnRange / warnRadius / warnClose / warnSeconds: an evil aura is warned before a fight (held off at warnRadius; coming closer than warnClose, or staying within warnRange for warnSeconds, starts it). alertRange: harm to one wolf provokes the others this close. sanctuaryGuard: while the player prays, the wolves stand guard this far away. shadowPatience: seconds a Shadow may stay in the Chapel without praying. friendRange, noticeRange, restSeconds, sleepSeconds, wanderRadius, besideHealth, besideStill: life at rest.

lockOn.comment: Souls-style target lock-on. Distances in cm, angles in degrees, speeds in 1/s. range / breakRange: acquire and hold distances. coneDegrees: half-angle from view centre to acquire. trackSpeed: how smoothly the view follows the target. losGrace: seconds of blocked line of sight before the lock breaks. switchMouse / switchStick / switchCooldown: horizontal flick to switch targets.

chapel.comment: The Drowned Chapel's interactions (interior stage 2). Each interactable: id, at [x, y, z] in cm, radius (how far off the line of sight it still counts), prompt (shown after the Interact key), text (shown when used; bracketed text marks a placeholder until the creator writes the real words), pray (the kneeler). reach: how far from the eye something can be used. sounds: looping ambience placed in the rooms (Ambience/S_<name>), full volume within inner, silent at inner + falloff, scaled by the ambience setting. sparkAt / sparkRange / sparkGap: embers rising off the forge's coals while the player is near.

clock.comment: Destiny's Ark's time (New Direction): one real minute is one game hour (realSecondsPerHour 60) and a day lasts 144 hours; the pause menu stops it; prayer runs it prayScale times faster (86.4: the longest prayer in the design, three days, in five real minutes; the prototype's reading). Hour 0 is midnight; the game starts at startHour. keys: through the day, the window light's colour (linear RGB) and strength (light), the glass's glow (glass) the fog's brightness (fog) and the Chapel's general fills, as daylight through the windows (fill), each times the map's own; eased between keys, the last wrapping to the first. Night 0-28 and 116-144, dawn about 40, day 52-92, dusk about 104.

pack.comment: The Chapel wolves as a pack (milestone 6). count: wolves in the Chapel (1..4; development builds change it live). spawns: each wolf's place and rest [x, y, yaw], the first the lone wolf's. Overwhelmed, when the pack allows a one-on-one (the creator's rule, 2026-11-23): any of Health below overwhelmedHealth of full, surroundCount wolves within surroundRadius cm, or hitsCount hits within hitsWindow seconds. oneOnOneLinger: seconds the one-on-one lasts after that. holdBackRadius: how far the others stand back. waitRadius: taking turns, how far the waiting wolves circle (outside surroundRadius, so waiting is not surrounding). turnTimeout: a turn holder that has not attacked for this long (blocked, stuck) passes the turn.

combatText.comment: Comic-book combat text (milestone 7). Every line is the creator's to write: replace a placeholder object with a plain string ("Your line") and it shows without the PLACEHOLDER tag. Lines of an event take turns in order. chance: after a speaker's first line of an event, the chance a later one is said. globalGap / speakerGap: seconds after any line / after the same speaker's last line. maxVisible: lines on screen at once. life*: seconds on screen (base + per character, clamped). popSeconds: the jump-out (reduced flashing fades in over fadeIn instead). maxWidth: virtual canvas units (1920 x 1080) before a line wraps.
